component.name: TagRex
component.summary: Edit music tags and file names in a table

description.p: A free tag editor for your music library. Edit tags and file names in a table, see exactly what will change before anything is written, and roll any batch back, even after a restart. Fill tags from Discogs, MusicBrainz, Beatport, Bandcamp and Soundeo.

A folder is the library: point TagRex at one and it recurses. Files load into a spreadsheet-style table with configurable tag columns, grouping, filtering and saved presets, and tag cells edit in place.

Nothing is written until you look at it. Every operation that changes files in bulk produces a change plan, rendered as a diff in the table itself, and applying it goes through a persistent undo journal.

ul.li: Tagger: edit tags by hand or pull them from online sources, with release cards, cover browser and track matching
Renamer: rename files and sort them into folders from one mask
Generator: text transforms such as case conversion, find and replace, transliteration and key notation
Deduplicator: a read-only scan for likely duplicates
Exporter: playlists, CUE sheets, CSV, HTML, XML and mask-based reports
Library health checks, field locks, tag block conversion and a preview player

screenshot.caption: A library grouped by folder, with the online lookup panel
A rename previewed as a diff inside the table

description.p: This release is mostly about keeping your files safe. Writing tags no longer damages WAV files, and a WAV already damaged that way is repaired by its next edit. MP3s with padding before their audio, which refused every write, can be tagged again. A cell you edit in the table is written when you press Enter, and undo takes it back.
